verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server that gives Claude, Cursor, Copilot and other agents natural-language access to metrics, logs, traces and alerts. It also publishes Agent Skills for generating queries over all three signals and offers service accounts for programmatic API access by external integrations, with documented debugging use cases such as investigating what changed after a deploy. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/REST query spec (the probe found 404s at standard paths), first-party docs for raw query API endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents debugging production.
